strategy.offer: Develops and manufactures specialized machines, vehicles and related services for underground work, construction, lifting and industrial transport tasks.
strategy.customers: Serves industrial and commercial operators needing safe, reliable equipment for mining, tunnelling, infrastructure, material handling and other demanding environments.
strategy.why_we_win: Expects to win through durable, customizable, safety-focused equipment, strong quality control, easy maintenance, and attentive service that solves customers' operational problems.
strategy.resources: Bases this on long engineering experience, continuous product improvement, certified quality processes, broad application know-how, and service capabilities including parts, training and after-sales support.
strategy.direction: Aims to keep advancing specialized equipment with new designs and technology, improving safety, efficiency and environmental performance across demanding applications.
